name: Jog nudge: correct and settle
lesson:
## Overshoot, then take it back

Forward for a beat, then backward for a beat, on bar 2 and bar 4; the mirror (back then forward) on bars 6 and 8. The second movement is the small opposite nudge you make when the first one went a touch too far.

This is a controlled version of what your hands will do in a real mix: the first nudge gets you close, the second one is a fraction of it in the other direction, and then you stop. Make the second push visibly smaller than the first. Equal pushes mean you are back where you started.
